wine_yeast.name: Yeast
wine_yeast.flavorText: A versatile yeast culture with countless uses, from leavening bread to brewing. For winemaking, it speeds up fermentation and improves the quality of the brew.

wine_superyeast.name: Super Yeast
wine_superyeast.flavorText: A highly potent, all-purpose yeast culture prized across countless crafts. For winemaking, it dramatically speeds up the fermentation process.

wine_yeast_red.name: Synthetic Yeast
wine_yeast_red.shortDescription: An illegal substance that can be used instead of yeast to cheaply produce mildly carcinogenic wine. Requires only water.

wine_yeast_infinite.name: Yeast Bioreactor
wine_yeast_infinite.shortDescription: An infinite source of yeast. Will be returned to inventory when fermentation starts instead of being consumed.
wine_yeast_infinite.flavorText: A self-sustaining culture vat that continuously regrows its own yeast.

wine_bottle.name: Wine Bottle
wine_bottle.shortDescription: A fancy glass bottle used for fermenting wine. This one has a integrated airlock.

wine_berry.name: BloomBerry
wine_berry.flavorText: A sweet berry modified for hydroponic growth. While not particularly filling, it's one of few fruits that is accessible in the Lower Levels. Good for making wine.
